requirements: Not a directory — coverage is earned editorial; no submission form or listing product
India edition operated under license (Fork Media Group); pitches must be India-relevant or use the global Mashable news inbox
Global Mashable contact page routes tips/press releases to a news@ editorial address — the only address that reaches the editorial team
Advertising inquiries for India go to teammashable.india@forkmediagroup.com — that is a paid-placement route, not editorial
preparation: A story angle that fits Mashable's verticals: tech, digital culture, entertainment, science — India angle preferred for this edition
Short pitch with the hook, evidence, and why now; press release if available
Decide editorial vs paid: editorial pitch (news inbox) vs sponsored content (advertise page)
workflow: Draft a concise pitch aimed at Mashable's editorial coverage areas
Send news/press-release submissions to the Mashable news editorial address listed on mashable.com/about/contact-us
For India-specific pitches or sponsored placements, use the Mashable India advertise contact (teammashable.india@forkmediagroup.com) — but label sponsored inquiries honestly
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article — no listing page is created
watchFor: The catalog's stored URL (in.mashable.com/website-informati) is a truncated path — the real pages live under /website-information/<id>/<slug>
The India 'contact' surfaced on the advertise page is a sales inbox — do not send editorial pitches expecting earned coverage there
Two different operators: global Mashable (Ziff Davis) vs India licensee (Fork Media) — pitch routing differs
SaaS launch news is a weak fit for Mashable's consumer-culture editorial mix unless there is a strong India or consumer-tech hook
countsAsLive: A Mashable India article mentioning the product is published at in.mashable.com
unknowns: A dedicated India editorial/tips inbox — only the advertising address was found for the India edition
Whether global editorial forwards India-relevant pitches to the India team
